title: vantage test suite
description: A vantage endpoint-test suite: suite-level defaults plus the steps (setup) and tests (asserted) to run. Keys beginning with an underscore (e.g. _note) are treated as free-form annotations and ignored.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, so editors validate the file inline.

url.description: Base URL applied to requests that do not set their own. Supports {{variable}} templates.

headers.description: Headers merged into every request; request-level entries win on conflict.

sorts.description: JSON pointers to array fields sorted before comparison.

ignored_fields.description: Field paths stripped from responses before comparison.

steps.description: Setup requests run before the tests; not asserted, but their captures feed the dictionary.

tests.description: The asserted requests that make up the suite.

before_all.description: CLI actions run once before the steps.

after_all.description: CLI actions run once after the tests.

onFailure.description: continue: log a WARN and keep going. fail: fail the owning step/test. abort: stop the whole suite.

payload.description: Request body (any JSON). {{variable}} templates are resolved before sending.

capture.description: name -> JSON pointer into the response body (empty string = the whole body). The name may itself be a template.

expected_status.description: Expected HTTP status (default 200). A status >= 400 marks the request as a warm-up in benchmark mode.

expected_response.description: Expected body (any JSON), compared after ignored_fields/sorts. Supports {{variable}} templates.

before.description: CLI actions run before this request.

after.description: CLI actions run after this request, even when it fails.

forEach.description: Runs the body once per item of a list.

in.description: Item source: an array variable name (string), or an inline request that fetches one (object).

items_path.description: JSON pointer to the array within the source (empty = the source itself).

as.description: Names the current item in the loop scope (default "item"): {{item}} is the item, {{item/field}} a field of it.

sequence.description: Loop body: an ordinary request sequence. Empty = the host request is the body (single-call loop).

capture.description: Values persisted from the iteration scope into the parent dictionary: name -> {key, value} builds dictionary[name][key] = value.

limit.description: Safety cap on the number of iterations (default 100).

run.description: Command template, resolved against the current scope.

shell.description: Shell override (sh, bash, powershell, cmd, or a program name).

capture.description: Dictionary variable receiving the trimmed stdout (JSON auto-parsed).
